transcript.text: แค่ได้มองดูเธอแต่ละวัน  แค่ได้เห็นเธอเป็นสุขฉันก็พอใจ

translations.ja: 毎日君を見つめるだけで、君が幸せそうな姿を見るだけで僕は満足なんだ
translations.en: Just getting to watch you every day, just seeing you happy is enough for me

translations.pt: Apenas poder olhar para você todos os dias, apenas poder ver você feliz, já me basta

translations.en: I don't hope for anything more than that. Just to get to see you smile

translations.id: Tidak berharap apa pun yang lebih dari itu Just to get to see you smile
translations.pt: Não espero nada além disso, Just to get to see you smile
